notes: Customer profile: mid-market B2B SaaS, product analytics + in-app help chat. High ROI on improving TTR and self-serve conversions.
On trial: started on Redwood Hosted API to validate prompt templates and response format. Promising latency but needs predictable SLOs under sustained load.
CTO quote on 2026-02-28 call: "We need predictable P95 < 150ms for chat flows and a clear fallback if model degrades. Also strict data residency for EU customers."
Primary POC goal: validate Dedicated throughput for peak collection jobs (20 qps with 2x burst), canary path for model rollouts, and automated rollback criteria.
Latency/throughput targets: P95 < 150ms for short chat turns, steady-state throughput 20 rps, burst to 50 rps without >20% tail-latency degradation.
Cost sensitivity: target blended cost ~ $0.01/token equivalent for production queries; open to commit discounts if Dedicated demonstrates 30-50% unit-cost savings vs hosted.
Model preferences: prefer open model variants (LLM-2-chat family or similar), but want ability to route to smaller quantized variant for cheap fallbacks. Require model pinning and versioned rollouts.

Routing & fallback plan discussed: primary region EU (FR), fallback region US (us-east) in case of outage; model variant fallback: full-precision -> int8 quantized -> smaller distill model. Canary strategy: 1% traffic for 24h -> 5% for 48h -> 20% for 72h; rollback if error rate >2% or latency P95 increases >25%.

POC acceptance criteria: instrumentation in Console (token-level cost, per-route latency), successful VPC peering, KV/prefix caching reduces token usage by >=15% for common prompts, canary rollout executed with automated rollback test.

Security: require SSO/SAML, audit logging with 13-month retention, KMS integration for keys, and data residency guarantee for EU customer data. Need support for SOC2/ISO answers (docs provided in Drive).
Action items from last call: SE to provide Dedicated sizing worksheet, infra to draft VPC peering runbook, legal to circulate DPA template. AE to schedule POC kickoff once DPA approved.
Customer sentiment: proactive and technical; product and infra teams engaged. Procurement timeline tied to next quarter budget review (May).
